summary: This directory provides a testing environment for validating the holiday synchronization service, ensuring that market holiday data processing, fetching, and reconciliation logic function correctly according to defined business rules.
responsibilities: Verify the accuracy of synchronized market holiday records
Validate business logic governing holiday data updates
Ensure the reliability of service operations through automated checks
relationships: The test suite acts as a verification layer for the holiday synchronization service to ensure it adheres to required business processes.
Automated tests evaluate the reconciliation logic between fetched data and the existing database state.
designDecisions: Co-location of tests with the corresponding service implementation
Utilization of behavioral verification to ensure data integrity
Isolation of service logic to facilitate unit and integration testing
